title: test-agent
description: Use this when you need an agent that runs test suites and reports results.

invocation.description: Declarative agent — host reads the prose body and renders the host header from agent/render at install time.

agent.name: test-agent
agent.description: Runs the project's test suites and reports what actually happened — the exact command, the exit code, the first failing assertion, and the minimal reproduction.
